  • Method Details

    • analyse

      public void analyse()
      Performs scope analysis for the entire program. This method analyzes all top-level function declarations first, and then analyzes the remaining statements in program order. Any scope-related errors are reported via VVPLController.error(int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String).

      Parameters:

    • visitBlockStmt

      public Void visitBlockStmt(Stmt.BlockStmt blockStmt)
      Analyses a block statement by constructing a new environment for the block, subsequently analysing each statement within this scope. Raises an error if one of the non-final statements is a return statement.
      Specified by:
      visitBlockStmt in interface StmtVisitor<Void>
      Parameters:
      blockStmt - the block statement

    • visitFunctionStmt

      public Void visitFunctionStmt(Stmt.FunctionStmt functionStmt)
      Analyses a Function Statement. An error is raised if: - the function statement occurs in a non-global environment - the function has already been declared - the function parameters are named similarly If no error is raised, the global flag global is_function_env is set and the body of the function is analysed.
      Specified by:
      visitFunctionStmt in interface StmtVisitor<Void>
      Parameters:
      functionStmt - the function declaration statement

    • visitReturnStmt

      public Void visitReturnStmt(Stmt.ReturnStmt returnStmt)
      Analyses a return statement by using is_function_env set by visitFunctionStmt(FunctionStmt). Error is raised if a return statement occurs outside of a function body.
      Specified by:
      visitReturnStmt in interface StmtVisitor<Void>
      Parameters:
      returnStmt - the return statement

    • visitCallExpr

      public Void visitCallExpr(Expr.Call call)
      Analyses a Call Statement. An error is raised if: - the function name is not defined - the number of given arguments does not match the number of necessary parameters. If no error is raised, the arguments are analysed.
      Specified by:
      visitCallExpr in interface ExprVisitor<Void>
      Parameters:
      call - the call expression
